resources.string: Give Krinik Tribit the «Nearby devices» permission. With it, Krinik Tribit sees the speaker paired with this phone.
Tap «Bluetooth settings», turn Bluetooth on and connect the speaker to the phone. When you come back to Krinik Tribit, Krinik Tribit connects to the speaker.
Turn %1$s on, tap «Bluetooth settings» and connect the speaker to the phone. When you come back to Krinik Tribit, Krinik Tribit connects to the speaker.
Pair %1$s with this phone in the Bluetooth settings. A paired speaker plays the phone\'s sound, and Krinik Tribit connects to it.
The speaker is connected to the phone, but Krinik Tribit cannot control the speaker. If another app for Tribit speakers is running on the phone, close it. Tap «Connect».
The speaker turns off after the chosen time.
Sleep timer on the speaker: %1$d min.
Move a band slider and release it. The speaker switches to the custom equalizer, and all ten bands take the levels shown on the sliders.

The settings file keeps the speaker\'s equalizer and light. Tap «Save to file» and pick a folder on the phone. You can send this file to a friend who has Krinik Tribit and a Tribit StormBox Blast 2 speaker. «Open file» puts the equalizer and the light from the chosen file on the speaker.
The equalizer file was not saved. Tap «Save to file» and pick another folder.
File read. Krinik Tribit puts the equalizer from the file on the speaker (and the light, if the file has it) when it connects to the speaker.
The chosen file is not a Krinik Tribit settings file. Pick a file saved with «Save to file».
The chosen file holds settings of another speaker model. Krinik Tribit opens settings files of the Tribit StormBox Blast 2.
The settings file is damaged: it has values the speaker does not take. Pick another file.
Krinik Tribit could not read the chosen file. Pick another file.
Krinik Tribit is an open-source app for the Tribit StormBox Blast 2 Bluetooth speaker.
Krinik Tribit is an independent project. Tribit is a trademark of Thousandshores.
Auto power-off, volume indicator, sleep timer, voice prompts, microphone
Drag the point of a band and release it. The speaker sets the band as the graph shows it.
Drag the point of a band and release it. The speaker sets the band as the graph shows it, and the equalizer «%1$s» keeps the new position of the band.
Turn the phone sideways: the name and the buttons move to the left, the graph takes the rest of the screen width.
Enter a name for the equalizer and tap «Create». The speaker switches to the new equalizer: all ten bands stand at 0 dB.
The file holds the equalizer that is on the speaker now. The Import button of Krinik Tribit opens this file and puts its equalizer on the speaker.
